university.name: University of Warwick
university.summary: A university with undergraduate and postgraduate taught courses across business, law, engineering, computing, sciences and social sciences. It publishes banded overseas tuition fees, offers an International Foundation Programme, and lists StEPS, StudyIn and IDP as its representatives in Pakistan.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.overview: Three-year degree covering programming, computer architecture, mathematics and theoretical computing in the early years, with an individual project and optional modules in the final year. Applicants need A-level Mathematics or equivalent.
highlights: Optional modules in areas such as artificial intelligence, computer graphics and computer security (optional; individual module titles not listed on the course page)
courses.academic_requirements: Typical offer A*A*A including A* in Mathematics (contextual offer A*AA including A in Mathematics). IB: 39 points with 7, 6, 6 at Higher Level including 7 in Higher Level Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches); contextual offer 38 points including 6 in Higher Level Mathematics. GCSE English Language and Mathematics (or a Science) at grade 4/C or above.
courses.english_requirements: Band A. IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in each skill; PTE Academic 60 overall with at least 59 in each Communicative Skill; TOEFL iBT (tests before 21 January 2026) 87 overall with minimums of 21 Listening, 21 Writing, 22 Reading, 23 Speaking; Duolingo 110 overall with at least 100 in each skill (individual skill scores required). The score table was published for September 2026 entry.
courses.notes: UCAS code G400. Course page shows a start date of 27 September 2027 and Band A. Fee: Computer Science is listed in Band 2 on the overseas fees page, 2027/28 figure 37,310 GBP. English score table is labelled September 2026 entry. No Pakistan-specific requirement found.

courses.title: Economics
courses.duration_text: 3 years full time (4 years with study abroad)
courses.overview: Three-year economics degree with core modules in the first two years and a wide choice of optional modules in the final year. A-level Mathematics or equivalent is required.
courses.academic_requirements: Typical offer A*AA including A in Mathematics (contextual offer AAB including A in Mathematics). IB: 38 points including 6 in Higher Level Mathematics; contextual offer 34 points including 6 in Higher Level Mathematics.
courses.english_requirements: Band C. IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in each skill; PTE Academic 75 overall with at least 59 in each Communicative Skill; TOEFL iBT (tests before 21 January 2026) 100 overall with minimums of 21 Listening, 21 Writing, 22 Reading, 23 Speaking; Duolingo 130 overall with at least 120 in each skill (individual skill scores required). The score table was published for September 2026 entry.
courses.notes: UCAS code L100. Course page shows a start date of 27 September 2027 and Band C. Economics (3 and 4 years) is listed in Band 2 on the overseas fees page, 2027/28 figure 37,310 GBP (course page itself shows the 2026/27 figures only). Module names are not listed on the page, so highlights are empty. No Pakistan-specific requirement found.

courses.title: Law
courses.overview: Three-year law degree with core legal skills modules in the first year, two core modules in the second year and a required supervised project in the final year.
highlights: Supervised Project in the final year (required)
courses.academic_requirements: Typical offer A*AA (contextual offer AAB). IB: 38 points typical, 34 points contextual.
courses.english_requirements: Band C. IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in each skill; PTE Academic 75 overall with at least 59 in each Communicative Skill; TOEFL iBT (tests before 21 January 2026) 100 overall with minimums of 21 Listening, 21 Writing, 22 Reading, 23 Speaking; Duolingo 130 overall with at least 120 in each skill (individual skill scores required). The score table was published for September 2026 entry.
courses.notes: UCAS code M100. Course page shows a start date of 27 September 2027 and Band C but does not name its fee band. The overseas fees page lists Law (3 years) LLB under Band 1, 2027/28 figure 29,260 GBP. Module names are not listed on the page. No Pakistan-specific requirement found.

courses.title: Mechanical Engineering
courses.overview: Three-year BEng in mechanical engineering. Applicants need Mathematics and Physics at A-level or equivalent.
courses.academic_requirements: Typical offer AAA including Mathematics and Physics (contextual offer AAB including Mathematics and Physics). IB: 36 points including 6 in Higher Level Mathematics and 6 in Higher Level Physics; contextual offer 34 points including 5, 5 in Higher Level Mathematics and Physics.
courses.english_requirements: Band A. IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in each skill; PTE Academic 60 overall with at least 59 in each Communicative Skill; TOEFL iBT (tests before 21 January 2026) 87 overall with minimums of 21 Listening, 21 Writing, 22 Reading, 23 Speaking; Duolingo 110 overall with at least 100 in each skill (individual skill scores required). The score table was published for September 2026 entry.
courses.notes: UCAS code H300. Course page shows a start date of 27 September 2027 and Band A but does not name its fee band. The overseas fees page lists Mechanical Engineering (BEng, MEng) under Band 2, 2027/28 figure 37,310 GBP. The module headings on the page are empty, so highlights are empty. No Pakistan-specific requirement found.

courses.title: Management
courses.overview: One-year taught master's in management with six core and four optional modules over three terms, ending in a research paper or a self-sourced internship. Open to applicants from a range of undergraduate subjects.
highlights: Six core modules (titles not listed on the page for 2027)
Optional modules, with examples named as Entrepreneurship, International Business and Big Data Analytics
courses.academic_requirements: A 2:1 undergraduate degree from a UK university or an overseas equivalent. Applicants from arts, social sciences, humanities, engineering and mathematics backgrounds are welcome.
courses.english_requirements: Band B. IELTS overall 7.0, with two components at 6.0 or 6.5 and the rest at 7.0 or above. The postgraduate English page lists IELTS only; other approved tests are on a separate page that was not read.
courses.experience_requirements: No formal work placement is required.
courses.application_deadline_note: On-time deadline for September/October 2027 start is 2 August 2027; later applications are accepted but timely processing is not guaranteed.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: 2027/28 postgraduate fees are expected in October per the fees page. The 2026/27 overseas fee of 38,570 GBP is recorded. The course page shows a start date of 27 September 2027 and does not state the fee itself. Module information on the page mostly relates to 2026/27. No Pakistan-specific requirement found.

courses.title: International Commercial Law
courses.duration_text: 1 year full time (2 years part time also offered)
courses.overview: Taught LLM in international commercial law with a foundation module, specialist options, a research and writing seminar and a dissertation.
highlights: Specialist options in advanced commercial law (optional)
courses.academic_requirements: A 2:1 undergraduate degree or equivalent in law or a related subject with a law component. Other internationally recognised qualifications are welcomed.
courses.english_requirements: Band B. IELTS overall 7.0, with two components at 6.0 or 6.5 and the rest at 7.0 or above. The postgraduate English page lists IELTS only; other approved tests are on a separate page that was not read.
courses.application_deadline_note: On-time deadline for September/October 2027 start is 2 August 2027; later applications are accepted but timely processing is not guaranteed.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: the 2026/27 full-time overseas fee of 25,340 GBP is recorded (part time 12,670 GBP). Module list on the page is not tied to a year and reflects modules running in the current year. Course page shows a start date of 27 September 2027. No Pakistan-specific requirement found.

courses.title: Cyber Security Engineering
courses.overview: Twelve-month MSc run by WMG covering cyber risk and compliance, network security, cryptography, digital forensics, ethical hacking and proactive cyber defence, with one elective.
courses.academic_requirements: UK 2:1 undergraduate degree or equivalent. A UK 2:2 (or equivalent) may be accepted with demonstrated relevant professional experience.
courses.english_requirements: Non-native speakers must submit a Secure English Language Test (SELT) result. IELTS overall 6.5 with no component below 6.0. The page gives no separate listening or speaking values.
courses.experience_requirements: Relevant professional experience may allow entry with a 2:2.
courses.application_deadline_note: Application deadline 31 August 2027; the course may close early if capacity is reached.
courses.notes: Course page states an overseas fee of 39,330 GBP for 2027 entry. The central postgraduate fees page shows 37,460 GBP for 2026/27, which is a different year, not a conflict. Module catalogue links on the page are labelled 2025 and the page says updates are expected, so modules may change. No Pakistan-specific requirement found.

scholarships.name: Warwick PGR Scholarships 2027 (including Faculty Chancellors and Interdisciplinary Chancellors streams)
scholarships.value_text: Full academic fees, a tax-free stipend at the UKRI rate for 3.5 years and a 5,000 GBP Research Training and Support Grant (Chancellors streams)
scholarships.summary: Competitive PhD scholarships for autumn 2027 entry. Faculty Chancellors awards are open to any nationality or fee status. Other streams have project, background or nationality conditions. Scholarships cannot be deferred.
scholarships.criteria_text: Faculty Chancellors stream: any nationality or fee status, not currently a Warwick PGR student. Must start in 2027/28. Other streams (Interdisciplinary Chancellors, AHRC, Doctoral Access Pathway and Sanctuary, China Scholarship Council) have their own conditions.
scholarships.deadline_note: Course application by 7 December 2026, scholarship application by 10 December 2026 (16:59 GMT), references by 21 December 2026. Offers released 5 March 2027.
scholarships.notes: Page also mentions support towards UK visa and immigration costs for eligible international applicants.

scholarships.name: WMG Pakistan Bursary
scholarships.value_text: Automatic tuition fee discount of 3,500 GBP
scholarships.summary: Automatic tuition discount for Pakistani nationals who are overseas fee payers and hold an offer for a full-time WMG MSc. Terms published for September 2026 entry; 2027 terms not yet seen.
scholarships.criteria_text: Pakistani national, overseas fee payer, self-funded or funded by a student loan, with an offer for a full-time WMG MSc on the Warwick campus.
scholarships.notes: Page last revised 25 August 2026 and refers to September 2026 entry. Confirm with WMG that the bursary runs for September 2027.

scholarships.name: WMG Pakistan Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: Competitive awards of 5,000, 10,000 or 15,000 GBP towards tuition fees, in addition to the Pakistan Bursary
scholarships.summary: Competitive tuition award for applicants with an offer for a full-time WMG MSc and a strong academic or professional profile, mainly for self-funded students. Terms published for September 2026 entry; 2027 terms not yet seen.
scholarships.criteria_text: Offer for a full-time WMG MSc, excellent academic track record and/or strong professional profile. Mainly for self-funded students; those on scholarship-loan schemes or partly funded externally may be considered. Covers tuition only.
scholarships.deadline_note: Apply within 4 weeks of receiving an offer. Four review rounds were published for 2026 entry, the last received by 12 June 2026.
scholarships.notes: Page states successful Excellence awardees receive both the bursary and the scholarship. The page does not explicitly restrict the Excellence Scholarship to Pakistani nationals, but it is published on the Pakistan scholarships page. Confirm with WMG.

scholarships.name: Warwick Undergraduate Global Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: No fixed amount. In 2025 the university offered 6 full-fee awards, 148 half-fee awards, 103 awards of 25% of fees and 6 awards of 2,000 GBP
scholarships.summary: Merit scholarship for overseas fee-status undergraduate and International Foundation Programme applicants who are self-funded. The published round is for autumn 2026 entry and has closed; no 2027 round has been seen.
scholarships.criteria_text: Classed as overseas for fees, applied to an undergraduate programme or the International Foundation Programme before the application cut-off, and not receiving a full tuition scholarship from another source.
scholarships.deadline_note: The 2026/27 round closed on 27 February 2026 at 12:00. The 2027 round has not been published.
scholarships.notes: The scholarships FAQ page says Warwick offers 20 full tuition fee scholarships for international undergraduates each year, with no further terms. Award is stated to run for the duration of the course.
